title: Flai’s AI dealership software is booking 50,000 appointments per month
snippet: Flai's revenue has grown 20x in a year, and the company just closed a $27 million Series A funding round.

title: Facebook tests going Reels-first in India
snippet: Meta is testing a new Facebook UX in India that sends some users directly into full-screen video when they open the app, putting Reels front and center.

title: Type One Energy raised $200M to build a fusion power plant by 2034
snippet: Type One Energy is betting that its lean approach to fusion power will get a power plant on the grid faster, and investors have rewarded it with $200 million.
